items.t: Bitcoin falls as Strategy faces MSCI index shake-up
items.sum: Scott Melker discusses the latest bitcoin (BTC-USD) sell-off and the implications for Michael Saylor's Strategy (MSTR) as MSCI revises its index eligibility guidelines. Melker examines how the changes could affect Strategy's index inclusion

items.t: MSCI Boots Strategy, and Trump picks his next crypto regulatory referees
items.sum: Scott Melker discusses MSCI kicking Michael Saylor's Strategy out of its index, but his bitcoin (BTC-USD) remains; Trump taps next regulatory crypto referees, and SoFi's (SOFI) dollar gets a Polygon address. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.t: Strategy Stocks Fall 3.64% as Bitcoin Breaks $70,000 Ahead of MSCI Exit
items.sum: Bitcoin now sits about 8% below Strategy's average cost, two weeks before MSCI drops the shares from its indexes.

items.t: MSCI Is Dropping Strategy From Its Indexes. JPMorgan Sees $2.8 Billion of “Forced Selling”
items.sum: Key TakeawaysMSCI is removing Strategy from its MSCI USA Index at the close of Nov. 30.

items.t: Strategy Raises $21B: Will It Fuel More BTC Purchases?
items.sum: MSTR raises $21.23 billion in 2026 to support its Bitcoin strategy, but shifting capital allocation and negative BTC Yield raise concerns.

items.t: Bitcoin Falls Below $70,000. Strategy Faces New Pressure After MSCI Exclusion
items.sum: Michael Saylor's company faces potential selling by index-tracking funds, with billions in additional outflows possible if other benchmark providers follow MSCI.
